name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,580

clue.text: Free NHS to be mauled further? Do this and feel better

indicators.note: something mauled is torn about and roughly handled, so the letters are knocked out of order

blocks.note: the letters of these two words, taken as written
further along is further up, as in moving up a list

explanation.surface: A complaint that the health service is being savaged even more by politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing and tidying yourself after a journey is a quick way of reviving and feeling more comfortable.

clue.text: Reasonable target in coconut shy?

blocks.note: first meaning: someone it is acceptable to criticise or attack
second meaning, read literally: a game played at a funfair

explanation.walkthrough: A coconut shy is a funfair stall where you throw balls to knock coconuts off posts, so it is a game at a fair.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means someone legitimately open to attack, while a fairground stall is literally a game found at a fair.

clue.text: Small space in church given up for Welshman

indicators.note: in a down clue, given up means the letters are sent upwards, so they read from bottom to top

blocks.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
the nave is the main central space of a church

explanation.surface: A church gives up a little of its room to accommodate a man from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Evans is one of the most common Welsh surnames, so a typical Welshman can be called by that name.

clue.text: Trouble with heart or comfort in retirement?

blocks.note: to be in hot water is to be in trouble
bottle is British slang for courage or nerve, as is heart

explanation.surface: An old person's worries: cardiac problems, or what brings ease once they stop working.
explanation.walkthrough: Retirement here is retiring to bed for the night, not leaving work.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubber vessel filled from the kettle warms the sheets, a comfort taken when retiring for the night.

clue.text: New look needing sash from Japan's capital

blocks.note: N is the abbreviation for new
an air is a look or manner, as in an air of confidence
the obi is the broad sash worn with a kimono

explanation.surface: A fresh outfit in Tokyo calls for a traditional sash.
explanation.walkthrough: Japan's capital looks like a single phrase meaning Tokyo; the possessive belongs to the sash, and capital stands alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Nairobi is the capital city of Kenya, so it is an example of a capital.

clue.text: Statement not binding: I say

indicators.note: not here means without, so one word is taken away from the other

blocks.note: a formal declaration or statement
cement is a substance that binds things together

explanation.surface: Someone declares that their remark is not legally binding.
explanation.walkthrough: I say reads like an exclamation; it means the word I, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: The word I is an example of a pronoun, a word standing in for a noun, signalled by say.

clue.text: Matured making appearance in teenage dream

indicators.note: the answer shows itself inside the following words, spanning their letters

blocks.note: the run of letters across the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: Growing up shows up in what a teenager dreams of.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left to mature, such as cheese or wine, has been allowed to grow older.

clue.text: Ruin surrounds husband immersed in drink, the rodent

indicators.note: surrounds puts one item around another
immersed in places a piece inside another, as if dunked in liquid

blocks.note: to undo someone is to ruin them
H is the abbreviation for husband
grog is rum mixed with water

explanation.surface: Wrecking a marriage by drowning the man in alcohol — the rat!
explanation.walkthrough: Rodent looks like an insult for the ruinous drinker, but it is meant literally. The husband sits inside the ruin, and that whole piece sits inside the drink just before its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The groundhog, or woodchuck, is a burrowing North American marmot, a member of the squirrel family of rodents.

clue.text: 20's colleague initially denied Jewish tribe

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word next to it

blocks.note: the opening letter of denied
Asher is one of the twelve tribes of Israel

explanation.surface: A co-worker is refused entry by a Jewish tribe.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 down is DANCER; Dancer and Dasher both pull Santa's sleigh.
explanation.definitionFit: Dasher works alongside Dancer in Santa's team of reindeer, making the two colleagues in the sleigh-pulling trade.

clue.text: Pear drop in line to be shared

blocks.note: Conference is a popular British variety of pear
to call on someone is to drop in for a visit

explanation.surface: A fruit falls into a queue of people waiting to divide it.
explanation.walkthrough: Pear drop looks like the boiled sweet, but the words split into a pear and drop in.
explanation.definitionFit: A telephone connection that several people join at once is a phone line shared between them.

clue.text: Not appropriate to have forty winks in it

indicators.note: to have something in a thing is to hold it inside

blocks.note: forty winks is a short sleep
taken as written

explanation.surface: Is it wrong to grab a snooze while at work?
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt describes something unsuitable or ill-fitting for the occasion, a close relative of inept.

clue.text: One lunatic, our son, holds party presenting no bouquet

indicators.note: a lunatic arrangement is a crazy one, so the letters are jumbled
holds means keeps something inside

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one
the letters of these words, taken as written
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A mad family man throws a party for his boy but forgets the flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: Bouquet looks like flowers, but here it is the scent of a wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Inodorous means having no smell, and a wine's bouquet is its aroma, so having none fits the word.

clue.text: Interrogators make move, receiving directions to bug

indicators.note: receiving means taking something in, so the other parts go inside

blocks.note: to go is to make a move in a game
E and S are compass points, east and south
to tap a phone is to bug it

explanation.surface: Questioners take action after being told to plant a listening device.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gestapo were Nazi Germany's secret police, notorious for brutal questioning of suspects.

clue.text: Crime committed by stolen goods receiver

blocks.note: by and of both name an author, as in a play of Shakespeare's
a fence is someone who handles stolen goods

explanation.surface: A crime carried out by the person who buys stolen property.
explanation.definitionFit: An offence is a breach of the law, the general term for any illegal act.

clue.text: Old PM with charisma making attractive point

blocks.note: a magnetic personality is a charismatic one
Lord North was British Prime Minister from 1770 to 1782

explanation.surface: A charming former prime minister makes a winning argument.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces appear in the clue in the opposite order to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnetic north is the place a compass needle is drawn towards, literally a point that attracts.

clue.text: Rabbit more appropriate for one to put in oven?

blocks.note: in British slang, to rabbit or to gas is to chatter on
fitter means more suitable

explanation.surface: Which is better suited to roasting, the rabbit?
explanation.walkthrough: Rabbit seems to be the meat for the oven; it is the verb for chatting.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who installs gas appliances is the person you would call to put a cooker in your kitchen.

clue.text: Tyres can burst in race

indicators.note: things that burst fly apart, so the letters scatter into a new order

blocks.note: the letters of these words, taken as written

explanation.surface: A puncture during a motor race.
explanation.walkthrough: Race looks like the motor race; it means lineage.
explanation.definitionFit: Race in the sense of stock or lineage is one's line of descent, which is what ancestry means.

clue.text: Star, protecting a chum, being disciplined killer

indicators.note: something disciplined is knocked into shape, so these letters are rearranged
protecting means wrapping around something to shield it

blocks.note: the sun is a star
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A celebrity shields a friend who is being punished, and the friend turns murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapid-firing automatic weapon is a deadly instrument, here called a killer as weapons sometimes are.

clue.text: Song about deceiver in rural idyll

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece is wrapped round the other

blocks.note: an aria is a solo song in opera
a cad is a man who treats women dishonourably

explanation.surface: A ballad about a seducer, set in an unspoilt countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcadia, a region of ancient Greece, became the poets' byword for an unspoilt pastoral paradise.

clue.text: Overhead protection from the rain

indicators.note: made from means built out of these letters in another arrangement

blocks.note: the letters of these words, taken as written

explanation.surface: An umbrella or shelter that keeps the downpour off.
explanation.walkthrough: Overhead protection from the rain suggests an umbrella; the anagram signal is the small word from.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine mesh worn over the hair holds it in place, a protective covering literally over your head.

clue.text: Performer in north circled by fish on river

indicators.note: circled by means surrounded, so one piece sits inside the other
in a down clue, on means placed above, so the next piece follows

blocks.note: the dace is a small freshwater fish
N is the compass abbreviation
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: An entertainer up north surrounded by fish beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A dancer is an artist who entertains an audience through movement, one kind of performer.

clue.text: American hippy? Not the first Charlie from the continent

indicators.note: not the first means the opening instance of a letter is dropped

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for American
sciatic means relating to the hip, so a joke for hippy
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An American flower child, not the original Charlie, hails from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: Hippy looks like a flower child; it is a playful word for having to do with the hip. Only the first of its two Cs goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Asiatic is an adjective meaning originating in Asia, so it describes something from that continent.

clue.text: Exhibiting culture, having dropped channel's latest repeat

indicators.note: latest points to the final letter of the word it follows
having dropped means one piece is let go from the longer word

blocks.note: a literate person is well read and cultured
the closing letter of channel

explanation.surface: A cultured viewer complains that a TV channel's newest show is a rerun.
explanation.definitionFit: To iterate is to say or do something again, the formal synonym of performing a repetition.

clue.text: Love makes an entrance we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the words are judged by their sound when spoken

blocks.note: a door is an entrance

explanation.surface: Someone in love makes a grand entrance, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to feel deep affection or devotion for them, a strong verb for loving.

clue.text: In bed, encouraged to introduce unknown plant

indicators.note: to introduce something is to bring it inside

blocks.note: a cot is a small bed
Y is a mathematical unknown
to lead someone on is to encourage them

explanation.surface: Someone in bed is egged on to bring a mystery stranger in.
explanation.walkthrough: Plant looks like a verb for planting evidence; it is botanical.
explanation.definitionFit: A cotyledon is the seed leaf of a seedling, and by extension the name of a genus of succulent plant.

clue.text: Short man needs time to receive oxygen at height

indicators.note: to receive something is to take it in

blocks.note: Alf is short for Alfred
T is the abbreviation for time
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A small man needs a moment to take in air when up high.
explanation.walkthrough: Short man sounds like a man of low stature; it is a shortened name.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloft means up in the air or high overhead, describing a position at an elevated height.

clue.text: Lightly cooked part missed in savoury dish

indicators.note: something missed is left out, so that portion goes

blocks.note: Welsh rarebit is melted cheese on toast
a bit is a part

explanation.surface: A cook skips part of a recipe for a lightly done savoury meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat served rare is only briefly seared and still red inside, the least cooked steak option.

clue.text: Offensive weapons bringing malevolence into main thoroughfare

indicators.note: into means placing one piece inside another

blocks.note: an artery is a main road or route
ill as a noun means harm or evil intent

explanation.surface: Tanks and guns roll down the high street with hostile intent.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery means large guns used in attack, so they are weapons used on the offensive.
